say:0:1810305001:1.text: A massive pair of pliers dominates the clinic, while an equally enormous saw is tucked away in a cabinet. Yet the surgical scalpels commonly used in human clinics have been left to gather dust.
say:0:1810305001:1.source_cn: 这是修缮屋里最醒目的工具——钳子，体型巨大。柜子里还收...

say:1:1810305002:1.text: Evidently, Baba Muriel is no conventional physician. Since her work mostly entails removing and replacing limbs, she is more akin to a carpenter of the body. That explains her choice of tools.
say:1:1810305002:1.source_cn: 很显然，修缮屋的主人绝非传统意义上的医生。她干的是卸胳...
